pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark brown polygonal and sub-ovate regions. Edges exhibit soft pixel gradients and rounded angularity. Individual patch area is significantly greater on the neck region compared to the mid-flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected cream-colored interstitial pathways. The topological graph is characterized by 3-way and 4-way junctions. Pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform, showing slight narrowing at the vertices between three or more adjacent patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette visible along the dorsal neck. The mane presents as a continuous, dark, bristled edge against the out-of-focus background.
